definitions.explanation: Colorful varieties of carp bred for decorative purposes, kept in garden ponds and displayed in competitions. Originally developed in Niigata Prefecture, they are now admired worldwide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{錦鯉|にしきごい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: Koi are swimming in the pond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{錦鯉|にしきごい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather's hobby is raising koi.

examples.japanese: {品評会|ひんぴょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧{錦鯉|にしきごい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数千万円|すうせんまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つくこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A koi that wins at a show can be worth tens of millions of yen.

notes:
Compound of {錦|にしき} (brocade, referring to the colorful patterns) + ⟦{鯉|こい}→鯉：02209_koi⟧ (carp). The voiced form ごい is due to rendaku.

Koi breeding originated in {新潟県|にいがたけん} during the Edo period. Major varieties include ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧ (red and white), {大正三色|たいしょうさんしょく} (red, white, and black), and {昭和三色|しょうわさんしょく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep koi)
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品評会|ひんぴょうかい} (koi show/competition)
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧ (koi farming)
